rules.career: Regular-season totals with the club since the franchise began, through the 2025 season. Sacks are in half sacks (124.5 sacks = 249) and follow what each club's own list says (official sacks only where the list says since 1982 or later). Tackles follow the club's own list; nflverse tackle counts are not comparable and are never used.
rules.season: The club's best regular season in the category, through 2025. season is the NFL season.
rules.game: The club's best regular-season game in the category, through 2025. season is the NFL season (January games belong to the season before); date is the game date when the guide prints it; week is the regular-season week when nflverse identifies the game.
rules.shipping: A value ships only when the club's own 2026 media guide and a second, independent source agree: the player's Wikipedia season table summed over the club, or nflverse play-by-play totals where they cover the whole career. A disagreement, a single source, a failed earlier rank or a failed completeness check keeps the row out; every candidate with its sources is in the evidence file.
rules.ranks: A club's list ships its longest run of verified ranks from rank 1. basis column: the guide prints the stat only as a column of a list ranked by another stat, so the order holds for the printed rows only (and for 1999-2025 careers nflverse confirms nobody is missing).
rules.links: link is the roster identity (primary pool index, name, birth date) of a player who is on the club's 2026 roster, so his total keeps counting; null otherwise.

footer_mapping.note: the ids are the footer's (nfl2k5_franchise_extension, j23-footer) and the history seed's; the club index is clubs[CODE].arena_index
footer_mapping.leaders: career.<category>[rank 1..3] -> leader_entry(person=pack_person(first, last, position), value, flags=LEADER_REAL, plus LEADER_LINKED and player=link.index when link is set); sacks_half is already in half sacks
footer_mapping.records: season.<category>[0] and game.<category>[0] -> record_entry(person, club arena index, value, year=season, week_row=week - 1 when week is set, else none); a record with tie is shared and the named holder is one of them
footer_mapping.not_covered: the records block's completions and forced_fumbles slots, and the league-wide leaders and records (the history seed has those)

sources.club_guides: Each club's own 2026 media guide (Internet Archive collection nfl-media-guides); the Steelers' 2026 guide is not online, so their 2025 edition is used and the 2025 season is added from nflverse.
sources.wikipedia: Wikipedia player articles, NFL career statistics tables (CC BY-SA 4.0), regular-season rows summed per club.
sources.nflverse: nflverse weekly player stats 1999-2025 (CC-BY-4.0), regular season, summed per club.

credits.club_guides: Record lists: each club's own 2026 media guide (the Steelers' 2025 guide), read from the copies in the Internet Archive collection nfl-media-guides. Facts only (names, years, numbers).
credits.wikipedia: Wikipedia player articles, text under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); facts only (regular-season statistics read from the articles' career tables).
